cars.name: Ford F-150 Lightning 2022-25
cars.note: The fork's secondary daily driver. In code (FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1) but deliberately hidden from the published CARS.md pending openpilot issue #30302; 2025 fingerprint is fork-added (with BluePilot) and known-good only on the dev channel — a frozen fallback build fingerprints it as MOCK/dashcam. Gets the fork's 4-signal lateral (panda reflash), ICBM stock-ACC curve control, per-car curve penalty and follow shaping.
